AdoptSuggestionIn.description: Adopt as proposed, or with an edited value and its citation note (decision `edited`).
AdoptSuggestionIn.title: AdoptSuggestionIn

AgentProposalOut.description:
`GET /v1/proposals/{ref}`: the C3 projection SHL-10 renders, for a generic proposal or a
typed adapter's (screener, upload reviewer, matcher).
AgentProposalOut.title: AgentProposalOut

AgentSuggestionOut.description: One proposed value for one target, after a person's decision.
AgentSuggestionOut.title: AgentSuggestionOut

AnalysisRequestOut.description: A recorded request for the run that raised the card (P-10 delivers it).
AnalysisRequestOut.title: AnalysisRequestOut

BulkFixInstructionsIn.description:
SHL-15 e: one shared editor; the scope is locked to the selection, so each issue gets
its own sealed instruction with scope `this_issue`.
BulkFixInstructionsIn.title: BulkFixInstructionsIn

BulkSignOffOut.description:
Each item decided on its own, atomically (R-SO-7). A replay with the same
`Idempotency-Key` returns this stored result.
BulkSignOffOut.title: BulkSignOffOut

CardDecideIn.description:
`POST /v1/decision-cards/{id}/decide`. No rationale answers 422 `rationale_required`; a
stale `seen_version` answers 409 `recommendation_changed`.
CardDecideIn.title: CardDecideIn

CardDecisionOut.description: The insert-only, human-only `decisions` row. The rationale is sealed.
CardDecisionOut.title: CardDecisionOut

CheckpointApproveIn.description:
A checkpoint that is no longer proposed, or whose hash differs, answers 409
`checkpoint_changed`; nothing is written.
CheckpointApproveIn.title: CheckpointApproveIn

CheckpointCreateIn.description: "Save checkpoint…": a person's named checkpoint of the target as it is.
CheckpointCreateIn.title: CheckpointCreateIn

CheckpointDecisionOut.description: The insert-only, human-only `checkpoint_decisions` row (SHL-16 b, e).
CheckpointDecisionOut.title: CheckpointDecisionOut

CheckpointDetailOut.description:
`GET /v1/checkpoints/{id}?compare=`: the card, its steps and the diff against `compare`
(the previous checkpoint, or current for an older one, SHL-16 c).
CheckpointDetailOut.title: CheckpointDetailOut

CheckpointDiffRowOut.description:
One field's old and new value, computed by code (`checkpoint_diffs`). Values are strings
and numbers are decimal strings; null is an empty cell ("—").
CheckpointDiffRowOut.title: CheckpointDiffRowOut

CheckpointHistoryOut.description:
`GET /v1/checkpoints`: one target's checkpoints, newest first, read like the sign-off
ladder (one target, bounded) rather than as a cross-record list.
CheckpointHistoryOut.title: CheckpointHistoryOut

CheckpointItemOut.description:
One checkpoint card. "Checkpoint {seq}" is its title unless it is named; `current` is
derived (ADR-160 clause 9) and never stored. `summary` may carry return figures
("Corrected Halvard 1099-INT (2,190 → 2,310)"), so it is Restricted and appears only in
one target's history read.
CheckpointItemOut.title: CheckpointItemOut

CheckpointRenameIn.description: Rename and star change only `name` and `starred` (SHL-16 d).
CheckpointRenameIn.title: CheckpointRenameIn

CheckpointRestoreIn.description: Restore creates a new checkpoint as a copy; nothing is deleted (SHL-16 c).
CheckpointRestoreIn.title: CheckpointRestoreIn

CheckpointStepOut.description: One step of the run that made the checkpoint (C6 run steps, read through review).
CheckpointStepOut.title: CheckpointStepOut

CheckpointTotalOut.description: The code-computed totals row ("Net change to total income · 0", a tie).
CheckpointTotalOut.title: CheckpointTotalOut

CitedSourceOut.description: A verified citation (C4) as its chip reads ("K-1 box 18A", "K-1 statement p. 3").
CitedSourceOut.title: CitedSourceOut

DecisionCardItemOut.description: A card in a list (HOME-02, the AUD-02 rail). No question text, options or rationale.
DecisionCardItemOut.title: DecisionCardItemOut

DecisionCardOut.description:
One card: the question, context, code-computed options, factors and, once decided, the
decision. A viewer outside the reserved role gets the same card with no decide action.
DecisionCardOut.title: DecisionCardOut

DecisionCardVersionOut.description: One history row: v1 proposed, v2 decided, v3 reassessed with no change (SHL-11 d).
DecisionCardVersionOut.title: DecisionCardVersionOut

DecisionContextOut.description: One context row ("Benchmark", "Amount", "Firm range", "Prior year"), from the owner.
DecisionContextOut.title: DecisionContextOut

DecisionOptionOut.description:
An option computed by the kind's provider in code, never by a model (ADR-050). Money is
a decimal string; `figures` are what the label and detail line show.
DecisionOptionOut.title: DecisionOptionOut

DecisionRecommendationOut.description:
The agent's recommendation (`decision_cards.recommendation_suggestion_id`). `reasons` are
agent text: the web app renders them only through AgentText.
DecisionRecommendationOut.title: DecisionRecommendationOut

EligibilityCheckOut.description:
One "Before you sign" row. `facts` are counts, dates and names for the row's sentence;
`refs` are what its link opens (the open notes, the issues).
EligibilityCheckOut.title: EligibilityCheckOut

ExplainAcceptedOut.description: 202: the explanation run started; its text arrives on the issue's detail.
ExplainAcceptedOut.title: ExplainAcceptedOut

FieldEditIn.description:
`PUT …/value`: a person's edit. The citation note is required (the `fvv_human_edits_cite`
CHECK); a stale `seen_seq` answers 409 `field_changed`.
FieldEditIn.title: FieldEditIn

FieldFlagOut.description: A field flag ("⚑ SI · Sep 11"): a review note anchored on the field.
FieldFlagOut.title: FieldFlagOut

FieldProvenanceOut.description:
`GET /v1/fields/{type}/{id}/{key}/provenance`: the tray behind ⓘ, newest version first.
Every field write answers with it too.
FieldProvenanceOut.title: FieldProvenanceOut

FieldReferenceIn.description: `POST …/references`: a document in this return; C4 verifies the citation.
FieldReferenceIn.title: FieldReferenceIn

FieldReferenceOut.description: A reference row: the imported return or the document page that proves the value.
FieldReferenceOut.title: FieldReferenceOut

FieldTickIn.description:
`POST …/ticks`: "Sign off field". An unsupported value answers 422 `uncited_change`; a
different current hash answers 409 `content_changed`.
FieldTickIn.title: FieldTickIn

FieldTickOut.description:
A field tick: a `field_tick` sign-off bound to the value's hash. `stale` is computed
("✓ KO · Sep 8 (before this change)").
FieldTickOut.title: FieldTickOut

FieldValueOut.description: A typed value as `field_value_versions.value` stores it: `{t, v}`, decimals as strings.
FieldValueOut.title: FieldValueOut

FieldVersionOut.description:
One insert-only `field_value_versions` row. `unsupported` is computed: no verified
citation, so the value cannot be ticked or approved. The pill (Updated, Edited, ≈,
Unsupported) is derived from these fields and never stored.
FieldVersionOut.title: FieldVersionOut

FixInstructionsAcceptedOut.description: 202: the instructions are recorded and the registered fix runner started a run.
FixInstructionsAcceptedOut.title: FixInstructionsAcceptedOut

HumanGateOut.description: One row of the rebuildable projection. Labels come from the subject's owner at read time.
HumanGateOut.title: HumanGateOut

IssueCreateIn.description: `POST /v1/issues`. "Create & send to client" is this, then `send-to-client`.
IssueCreateIn.title: IssueCreateIn

IssueDetailOut.description:
One issue with its sealed title, internal note and client wording. Only `client_wording`
ever reaches the client, as a request item through `send-to-client` (INV-4).
IssueDetailOut.title: IssueDetailOut

IssueExplanationOut.description: SHL-15 d, "Explain…": read-only agent text with its citations; it decides nothing.
IssueExplanationOut.title: IssueExplanationOut

IssueFixInstructionsOut.description:
The sealed instructions a person set. Fix runs always propose (DF-13): there is no
direct-edit mode, so the "Propose changes for my approval" box is not a wire field.
IssueFixInstructionsOut.title: IssueFixInstructionsOut

IssueFixRunOut.description:
The run fixing the issue (SHL-15 a-prime: "Adding 1,550 to Form 1040 line 2a · Running"),
then its proposal (a-double-prime: the ghost values; Accept opens SHL-10 b). `label` is
agent text.
IssueFixRunOut.title: IssueFixRunOut

IssueFixSuggestionOut.description: "Suggested by Accrued Agent": agent text, rendered only through AgentText.
IssueFixSuggestionOut.title: IssueFixSuggestionOut

IssueItemOut.description:
An issue in a list (TAX-06, TXP-10, AUD-15). The title, notes and client wording are
sealed and Restricted, so lists never carry them; the detail does.
IssueItemOut.title: IssueItemOut

IssueLinkOut.description:
A linked target: a cell range ("EBP-04 Participant data!F12:F15"), a form field ("Form
1040 · line 2a"), a file, a request item or a finding. The chip lights its target.
IssueLinkOut.title: IssueLinkOut

IssueResolutionIn.description: Resolve, verify, reopen or mark not applicable: a person's act (ISSUE-001).
IssueResolutionIn.title: IssueResolutionIn

IssueSendToClientIn.description: One request item through `requests.api` (P-06) carrying only the client wording.
IssueSendToClientIn.title: IssueSendToClientIn

IssueUpdateIn.description:
`PATCH /v1/issues/{id}`: title, class, priority and assignee. A stale `seen_version`
answers 409 `issue_changed`.
IssueUpdateIn.title: IssueUpdateIn

ProposalDecisionOut.description:
The latest insert-only, human-only `proposal_decisions` row. `undo_until` is the end of
the 10-second window (ADR-161 clause 6); null once an effect has started or for none.
ProposalDecisionOut.title: ProposalDecisionOut

ProposalEditIn.description: An edited After value with its citation note (SHL-10 "Approve with edits").
ProposalEditIn.title: ProposalEditIn

ProposalPolicyOut.description:
`proposals.policy_eval` and the policy note. While P-08 is dormant the approver is always
a named person, never "Policy" or the agent (INV-5).
ProposalPolicyOut.title: ProposalPolicyOut

ProposalRowOut.description:
One change: Field · Before → After · Cause. A row without a verified citation is
`unsupported` and blocks approval (422 `uncited_change`).
ProposalRowOut.title: ProposalRowOut

ProposalSetOut.description: SHL-10 g: the proposal's set. The link row opens SHL-19 and approves nothing.
ProposalSetOut.title: ProposalSetOut

ProposalTotalOut.description: A totals row computed by code ("Net change to Form 1040 total income · 0 · tie").
ProposalTotalOut.title: ProposalTotalOut

ReviewNoteDetailOut.description: One note with its sealed body and its insert-only events.
ReviewNoteDetailOut.title: ReviewNoteDetailOut

ReviewNoteItemOut.description:
A note in a list. Bodies are sealed and Restricted, so lists never carry them; the
detail read does, as an access event.
ReviewNoteItemOut.title: ReviewNoteItemOut

SignOffEligibilityOut.description: `GET /v1/sign-offs/eligibility`: the SHL-12 sheet for one level.
SignOffEligibilityOut.title: SignOffEligibilityOut

SignOffIn.description:
`POST /v1/sign-offs`: sign what was seen. A different current hash answers 409
`content_changed` and nothing is written.
SignOffIn.title: SignOffIn

SignOffLadderOut.description: `GET /v1/sign-offs`: the ladder per level on one target.
SignOffLadderOut.title: SignOffLadderOut

SignOffOut.description:
One insert-only `sign_offs` row. `stale` is computed (its hash differs from the target's);
no row is ever updated (ADR-160 clause 3).
SignOffOut.title: SignOffOut

SignOffTargetOut.description: What is being signed: the version and hash the signer sees (SHL-12 workpaper card).
SignOffTargetOut.title: SignOffTargetOut
